arrivalEssentials: Check whether any Thailand digital arrival requirement applies before boarding.
Have baht or a working card ready for rail fares, tolls, and your first meal.
If you are heading straight into Bangkok, compare Airport Rail Link versus taxi based on traffic and luggage.
Install Grab before landing if you want an easy app-based backup to regular taxis.

options.bestFor: Fast budget transfers into Bangkok with light luggage
options.notes: Connects easily into the BTS or MRT network depending on where you are staying.

options.typicalCost: About THB 350 to 500 plus tolls and airport fee
options.notes: Traffic can change the travel time a lot, especially in peak periods.

options.typicalCost: Usually similar to or slightly above taxi pricing
options.bestFor: App-based pickup and clearer cashless fare handling
options.notes: Pickup points may be less intuitive than the public taxi rank, so check the app instructions carefully.

entryRequirements.passportValidity: Carry a passport with at least 6 months validity beyond arrival.
entryRequirements.visaSummary: Australian passport holders commonly receive visa-exempt entry for short tourism visits, but business travel conditions and allowed stay lengths should be checked close to departure.
entryRequirements.arrivalCardOrDeclaration: Thailand currently uses the Thailand Digital Arrival Card for non-Thai nationals, so check the official TDAC requirement and submit it before arrival if it applies to your trip.
entryRequirements.officialSourceNote: Verify the latest Thai immigration guidance and use the official TDAC portal only.
importantNotes: Keep an onward or return ticket and accommodation details available.
Do not assume historical visa-free rules are unchanged; confirm the current allowance for Australians.

handyPhrases.context: Use khrap if male and kha if female.

handyPhrases.local: Khop khun khrap / Khop khun kha
handyPhrases.pronunciation: kop koon krap / kop koon ka
handyPhrases.context: A polite default in hotels, shops, and meetings.
Very useful when ordering street food or casual meals.

businessEtiquette.summary: Thai business culture often rewards calm politeness, patience, and respect for hierarchy.
tips: Avoid openly showing frustration in meetings.
Use titles and surnames until invited to be more casual.
A wai is appreciated in some settings, but follow the other person’s lead.

foodAndPracticalities.tapWater: Do not rely on tap water for drinking; bottled or filtered water is the safer default.
foodAndPracticalities.tipping: Tipping is not mandatory, but rounding up or leaving a small amount is common in tourist-facing venues.
foodAndPracticalities.dietaryNotes: Fish sauce and shrimp paste are common, so vegetarian or vegan travellers should ask directly.
foodAndPracticalities.commonFoodTips: Street food is one of the easiest low-cost options, but choose busy stalls with fresh turnover.
usefulPhrases: Gin jay dai mai? (Can I have vegetarian food?)

moneyAndPayments.cardAcceptance: Cards are common in hotels, malls, and larger restaurants, but small vendors may still prefer cash.
moneyAndPayments.cashNotes: Carry smaller notes for street food, local markets, and older taxis.
moneyAndPayments.tipping: Rounding up or leaving around THB 20 to 100 in service settings is common but not compulsory.
roughCostExamples: Beer at a casual bar or restaurant: about THB 90 to 180 (AUD 4 to 8)
BTS or MRT trip: about THB 20 to 60 (AUD 1 to 3)
Simple meal: about THB 60 to 150 (AUD 3 to 7)
Airport Rail Link from BKK: about THB 35 to 45 (AUD 2)

localTransportApps.name: Grab
localTransportApps.notes: The simplest app-based fallback when taxis are unclear or you want a fixed price in-app.

localTransportApps.name: Bolt
localTransportApps.notes: Can be cheaper than Grab in some cases, but availability varies.

localTransportApps.name: Google Maps
localTransportApps.notes: Useful for combining rail lines with short taxi hops.

emergencyNumbers.label: Police, ambulance, and fire
notes: 191 is the general emergency line commonly used for immediate help.
If you need tourist assistance, hotel staff can often help with English-language coordination.

disclaimer: Sample briefing only. Entry rules, health requirements, and transport conditions can change; always confirm current details with official sources before you travel.
